body:
CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: Fixed a real, live bug (founder screenshot: 'help' rendering as a garbled, staggered mess in a real Windows Git Bash/MINGW64 terminal over SSH): every multi-line send() ever sent a message with only ONE trailing CRLF, leaving every internal line break as a bare LF -- fine for telnet clients (which conventionally translate LF to CRLF themselves) but broken for a real Windows PTY-based SSH session, which does not. New normalizeLineEndings() (a real two-pass normalize, not a naive single ReplaceAll -- ~120 existing call sites already prepend a correct leading CRLF for spacing and must not get doubled), wired into player.send and both structurally identical local send closures (handleConn, runSSHClaimFlow). 3 new tests. Isolated from a concurrent in-flight main.go change, go build/vet/test ./... clean. Live-verified on a throwaway instance: raw socket capture confirms zero bare LF bytes remain in a real help response. Commit e652950 (source pushed; deploy deliberately held -- two live demo SSH sessions currently running for the founder's own stream). (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
